description:
Brand Introduction

Lova Jewellery is a bespoke jewelry brand specialising in personalised name logo monogram jewelry for women and men. We combine craftsmanship and creativity to turn names into wearable art. Our designs are meticulously handcrafted, blending elegance with individuality, ensuring that every piece is truly unique and cannot be found elsewhere.

Product Description

Our collection features a variety of custom-made jewelry, including:

  • Name Logo Necklaces: Designed by artistically transforming names into intricate logos, laser-cut to perfection.
  • Personalised Earrings: Unique monogram designs tailored to reflect your personality.
  • Exclusive Bracelets: Featuring custom name or logo engravings that elevate your style.

Each piece is a fusion of modern design and timeless craftsmanship, created with high-quality materials like sterling silver, gold plating, and other premium finishes.

USP (Unique Selling Point)

  1. One-of-a-Kind Designs: Our custom name jewelry goes beyond the standard designs, offering bespoke artistic pieces unavailable elsewhere.
  2. Laser Precision Crafting: Using advanced laser-cutting technology to achieve perfect detailing.
  3. Gender-Inclusive Range: Offering personalised jewelry for both men and women.
  4. Fast Global Delivery: Free and efficient shipping, with regional print centres in the UK, USA, Canada, and Europe to minimise delivery times.
  5. Exceptional Customer Experience: From design consultation to post-purchase support, we ensure a seamless and satisfying shopping experience.
  6. Eco-Friendly Practices: We prioritise sustainable sourcing and production methods.

Payment Terms

  • Commission Structure: Affiliates earn a competitive commission of [X%] per sale generated through their unique affiliate link.
  • Payment Frequency: Commissions are paid monthly via [preferred method, e.g., PayPal, bank transfer].
  • Minimum Payout Threshold: Affiliates must reach a minimum of £[X] in commissions before payments are processed.
  • Tracking Duration: Cookies last for [X days], ensuring affiliates are credited for all sales within this period.

Other Information

  • Marketing Materials: Affiliates will receive professionally designed banners, product images, and suggested captions to promote Lova Jewellery effectively.
  • Affiliate Portal: A user-friendly platform to track clicks, sales, and commissions in real-time.
  • Product Support: Detailed product information and personalised guidance to help affiliates confidently promote our offerings.
  • Exclusive Offers: Affiliates gain access to exclusive discounts and early previews of new collections for promotional purposes.
  • Performance Incentives: Top-performing affiliates can enjoy higher commission rates or bonus rewards.
  • Terms & Conditions: Affiliates must adhere to brand guidelines and ethical marketing practices, avoiding spam or misleading claims.
